14 Kona hotels, each priced on every booking site we recorded for it. Prices on this page are per night, all-in where the sites reported taxes and fees; the study's count below uses the before-tax prices of its CSV. The going rate is the price the largest number of listings that named a room or offered free cancellation agreed on (ties go to the lower price).

One snapshot on September 29, 2026 for Nov 3 to Nov 5, 2 adults, US market, USD. Prices change daily.

Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Kona hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 29, 2026 snapshot, at 10 of the 18 Kona hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 3, the hotel's own site at 3, Billabook.com at 1, Bluepillow.id at 1, Traveluro at 1 and Vio.com at 1. These are the Kona rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 10 of the 14 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 3, the hotel's own site at 3, Billabook.com at 1, Bluepillow.id at 1, Etrip.net at 1, Traveluro at 1 and Vio.com at 1 (a tie counts for each site). At the other 4, no site was 5% or more below it. The two counts differ: the study also counts the 4 named below that are not listed on this page. Each hotel below shows every site's all-in price. Across all cities: which booking site was lowest most often, measured.

Taxes and fees at Kona hotels

At the 9 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 19% ($56 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 18% at Kona Islander Vacation Club to 19% at Hale Maluhia Country Inn (House of Peace). At 5 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
